name: claude-mem (thedotmack)
hook: 74.4K stars. Claude Code plugin that hooks into 5 lifecycle events (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd) to automatically capture everything Claude does during coding sessions — then compresses observations via Claude's agent SDK and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Stores observations in SQLite with Chroma vector DB for semantic retrieval; web viewer at localhost:37777 shows the accumulating memory with token cost visibility and `<private>` tag support for opt-out.

name: caveman (JuliusBrussee)
hook: 57.4K stars. Claude Code skill that reduces output tokens 65–75% by instructing the model to drop articles, filler words, and pleasantries while keeping all technical substance — benchmarked at 1,214 normal tokens vs 294 caveman tokens per response across 10 test tasks. Four intensity levels: Lite, Full (default), Ultra, and Wenyan (Classical Chinese for maximum compression); auto-installs across 30+ agents. A March 2026 arXiv paper found that brevity constraints improved accuracy by 26 percentage points on problems where verbosity caused errors.

name: RTK — Rust Token Killer (rtk-ai)
hook: 45.5K stars. Single Rust binary (zero dependencies) that sits between Claude Code and the shell — intercepts stdout from 100+ commands (git, npm, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, AWS CLI) and compresses it 60–90% before it reaches the model. A 45-line `ls` output (~800 tokens) becomes 12 lines (~150 tokens); `git push` shrinks from 200 tokens to 10 tokens. v0.39.0 shipped May 6; `rtk gain` shows cumulative token savings across all sessions.

name: 9Router (decolua)
hook: 6.3K stars. Smart routing proxy that intercepts Claude Code requests and applies token compression before forwarding — saving 20–40% of token spend. Implements a 3-tier fallback (subscription providers first, cheap options second, free tiers last) so coding continues uninterrupted when quotas deplete. Configure via `~/.claude/config.json` with `http://localhost:20128/v1` as the API base; live quota tracking dashboard at `http://localhost:20128`.

name: graphify (safishamsi)
hook: 45.9K stars, v0.7.13 (May 9). Converts any codebase, SQL schema, PDF, image, or video collection into a queryable knowledge graph with a visual interactive HTML representation — processing code locally via AST with tree-sitter (zero API calls for source files), sending non-code files through AI for semantic analysis. Identifies 'god nodes' (most-connected concepts) and surfaces surprising cross-module relationships; 29 programming languages. Run `/graphify .` to generate `graph.html`, `GRAPH_REPORT.md`, and `graph.json`.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install
